description: This source file defines a RecyclerView adapter for displaying smart home devices in a list, with support for TV remote control input. It contains a class DeviceAdapter with an inner ViewHolder class managing device item views, including toggles, focus states, and key events.

classes.name: DeviceAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter class for displaying a list of smart home devices with TV remote control support.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and inflates the view holder for device items.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds device data to the view holder at the specified position.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of devices in the list.

methods.name: DeviceViewHolder.bind
methods.description: Binds a Device object to the ViewHolder’s views, setting up UI elements and event handlers.

methods.name: updateCardState
methods.description: Updates the background color of the device card based on its on/off state.
